posts.author: SakuraMiya
posts.body:
Recently I moved my game from VX Ace to MV, but I can't adapt this old script to it. Is it any way to make a puzzle that triggers an event when all tiles have been stepped on, and each tile may only be stepped on once, without relying on too many switches?
This is the original vx ace script

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Is this what you're asking for a translation of?
Ruby:
(1..21).each do |event_id|
    $game_self_switches[[@map_id, event_id, 'A']]
end
The page you linked actually has a translation of that into JavaScript:
JavaScript:
for (var event_id = 1; event_id <= 21; event_id++){
    $gameSelfSwitches.setValue([$gameMap.mapId(), event_id, 'A'], false);
}
Or is there something else you need help with? If so, please be more specific.
